plugin.soundboard.name: Soundboard
plugin.soundboard.description: Plays short sounds in a voice channel.
plugin.soundboard.setting.voice_channel_: Used when the member who triggers the node is not in a voice channel and the node names none.
plugin.soundboard.setting.stay_connected: Stay in the channel after "Stop sound"
plugin.soundboard.node.play_sound.label: Play sound
plugin.soundboard.node.play_sound.descri: Joins a voice channel and plays a sound of the plugin.
plugin.soundboard.node.stop_sound.label: Stop sound
plugin.soundboard.node.stop_sound.descri: Stops the sound and leaves the voice channel.
